set_games_info: Every installed Source 1 game (CSS, CS:GO, HL2, GMod, Portal 2 and others) is found automatically and its VPK files are searched for the materials and models a map needs. Nothing to set up.
help_p1:
1. In the Port Map tab, add the maps (.bsp) to the list.
2. Select a map and pick its addon from the list, or type a new name. Every map can go to another addon.
3. Press Port. Finished maps turn green in the list. Open the addon in Hammer and load the map.
help_p2: The map is decompiled and imported into CS2. The materials, models and sounds it uses are looked up in the map file and in the Source 1 games on your PC, then converted into the addon. The map itself is not compiled.
help_p3:
• Sky, lights, ropes, water, sounds and glow sprites become their CS2 versions.
• Entities that CS2 does not have become ones that do the same job, or are removed.
• func_detail and brush entities without inputs or outputs become plain meshes.
• Invisible walls made with clip textures stay player clips.
• Blend displacements keep their blending and textures stay in place.
• Bhop maps get the bhop script and its settings when they need them.
• Animated textures keep playing, and bhop blocks work with the bhop script.
• The map gets light probe volumes, each with a small white light room out of sight; they overlap a little and fade into each other.
• When the port ends you are told about anything that needs a look in Hammer.
• Materials that lit the map like lamps in Source 1 (texture lights) glow in CS2 and give the same light when the lighting is baked.
• The map's particle systems (its own and the game's) become CS2 particle systems.
• Glass with the refract shader gets a blurred, dark tinted look that works in CS2.
• Bhop timer zones and spawn points are set up the way CS2 servers expect them.
• A sky drawn from a cube texture becomes a normal CS2 sky, and surfaces that show it look into the sky.
• The map's color correction goes into its post processing, and under water the camera gets an underwater look.
• Water that lit its surroundings in Source 1 gets lights over it.
help_p4: On the Missing Assets tab pick the addon and its map, then press the button: every material and model the map uses is checked and the missing ones are converted. Select the original .bsp too, so its embedded files and its sky can be used. "Find a file" searches every source for a file by its name, and the files it finds can be exported into a folder. When you export a file, the files it needs (the textures of a material, the parts of a model) are listed first and you pick which ones go with it, then the folder.
help_p5: Files that are in no source show up in red in the table. The same list is also saved next to the report as missing_vmat_ref.txt and missing_vmdl_ref.txt.

opt_bhop_download_tip: Every port downloads the newest script from its link with one plain HTTPS request and keeps it next to the program; without a connection the saved copy is used. The program never runs the file, it only copies it into the addon. If a security program complains, turn this off.
opt_light_probes: Add light probe volumes with white light rooms
opt_light_probes_tip: The map gets env_combined_light_probe_volume entities over its geometry (Low Resolution, several smaller ones instead of one big one). Next to each other they overlap a little and fade into each other at their edges. Each one bakes its cubemap in its own small white room with a light, placed where players can not see it (outside the map, or inside a thick wall or the ground).
